slides.title: If your website were a restaurant.

slides.label: FRONTEND
slides.title: The dining room.
slides.body: Everything your customers see, touch and judge in the first 3 seconds.

slides.label: BACKEND
slides.title: The kitchen.
slides.body: Nobody sees it. But if it's a mess, everybody tastes it.

slides.label: API
slides.title: The waiter.
slides.body: Takes your order to the kitchen and brings back exactly what you asked for.

slides.label: DATABASE
slides.title: The pantry.
slides.body: Every ingredient labeled and stored, ready the second the kitchen needs it.

slides.label: AUTHENTICATION
slides.title: The bouncer.
slides.body: No ID, no entry. Not even if you say you know the owner.

slides.label: FULL-STACK
slides.title: The food truck guy.
slides.body: Cooks, serves, takes payment and fixes the generator. Alone.

slides.label: PROJECT MANAGER
slides.title: The maître d'.
slides.body: Three phones, twelve tables, one deadline. Somehow, everything ships on time.

slides.label: QA TESTING
slides.title: The food critic.
slides.body: Tastes every dish before your customers do, so nothing bad reaches the table.

slides.label: BUG FIXING
slides.title: The 11 pm mop.
slides.body: Someone spilled the sauce. We clean it up before the next guest walks in.

slides.label: DEPLOYMENT
slides.title: The grand opening.
slides.body: Doors open, lights on. Your website is live.

slides.title: We run the whole restaurant.
slides.body: Front of house to kitchen: design, development and launch, all in one place.
